name: 屋大维
description: 恺撒的养子和继承人。18岁，体弱多病但意志如钢。拥有最致命的武器——恺撒的名字和阿格里帕的军事天才。从一无所有到世界之主，只需要耐心和冷酷。
description_en: Caesar's adopted son and heir. 18 years old, sickly but iron-willed. His deadliest weapons: Caesar's name and Agrippa's military genius. From nothing to master of the world — all it takes is patience and ruthlessness.

name: 马克·安东尼
description: 恺撒最信任的副将，现任执政官。控制恺撒的老兵和国库。战场上无可匹敌的勇士，但政治和欲望总是让他分心。东方有财富、有克利奥帕特拉、有帕提亚——也有毁灭。
description_en: Caesar's most trusted lieutenant and current consul. Commands Caesar's veterans and treasury. Unmatched on the battlefield, but politics and desire always distract him. The East holds wealth, Cleopatra, Parthia — and destruction.

name: 克利奥帕特拉七世
description: 埃及最后一位伟大的法老。拥有地中海世界最富庶的粮仓和最古老王国的正统。会说九种语言，比她的罗马对手们更聪明——但她需要一位罗马盟友来保护埃及的独立。或者，她可以自己选择胜利者。
description_en: Egypt's last great Pharaoh. Controls the Mediterranean's richest granary and the legitimacy of the oldest kingdom. Speaks nine languages, smarter than her Roman rivals — but she needs a Roman ally to protect Egypt's independence. Or she can pick the winner herself.

name: 罗马元老院
description: 以西塞罗为首的共和派元老。共和国的最后守护者。他们没有军团，但有罗马城的钱袋、民众的舆论和五百年的传统。在这场巨人之间的战争中，话语可能是最锋利的武器。
description_en: The Republican faction led by Cicero. The last guardians of the Republic. They have no legions, but they have Rome's treasury, the people's voice, and five centuries of tradition. In this war of titans, words may be the sharpest weapon.

name: 塞克斯图斯·庞培
description: 庞培大帝之子，控制西西里岛和地中海无敌舰队。封锁意大利的粮食供应，让罗马城饥肠辘辘。他的命运取决于谁能先打败他的海军。
description_en: Son of Pompey the Great. Controls Sicily and an invincible fleet. Blockades Italy's grain supply, starving Rome. His fate depends on who defeats his navy first.

name: 雷必达
description: 恺撒的前骑兵长官，控制西班牙和南高卢。三巨头中最弱小但位置最安全——西班牙的银矿和北非的粮仓让他不容忽视。
description_en: Caesar's former Master of Horse. Controls Spain and southern Gaul. The weakest triumvir but in the safest position — Spanish silver and African grain make him relevant.

name: 布鲁图斯与卡西乌斯
description: 刺杀恺撒的「解放者」。正在东方集结共和派军队。他们的命运在腓立比战役（42 BC）见分晓。
description_en: The Liberators who killed Caesar. Gathering Republican armies in the East. Their fate will be decided at Philippi (42 BC).

name: 帕提亚帝国
description: 罗马在东方的永恒对手。冷眼旁观罗马人自相残杀，等待踏入叙利亚的最佳时机。
description_en: Rome's eternal rival in the East. Watches Romans destroy each other, waiting for the perfect moment to enter Syria.
